Chapter 1122: 39: Visitors From The Capital (Request Subscription)

Chapter 1122: Chapter 39: Visitors from the Capital (Request Subscription)

Lin Yuan stood in the void, quietly watching the form and spirit of King Lingshen disintegrate.

Then, he casually collected the various weapons and treasures left by this Da Ling royal family member.

“The royal families of the Da Ling Ancient Country, their methods are strange and difficult, especially that ability to transform into ‘spirit’, even a Heavenly Venerate would probably have a headache dealing with it.”

Lin Yuan sighed slightly in his heart.

Transforming into ‘spirit’ is to integrate into ‘spirit’ and become ‘spirit’.

And ‘spirit’ exists among all things; King Lingshen’s move, as long as it doesn’t face a Heavenly Venerate,

is practically invincible.

“But unfortunately… I just happen to completely counter it.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, King Lingshen transformed into ‘spirit’, blending into everything.

But Lin Yuan’s Physical Body Divine Ability ‘World’ forms an extrinsic universe centered on himself.

Within the scope of the extrinsic universe, he can control everything.

Actually, merely relying on the control power of the extrinsic universe, even if he can suppress King Lingshen who has become ‘spirit’, has merged into ‘spirit’, it is still difficult to force him out.

The duration of the extrinsic universe is limited.

But after Lin Yuan’s internal universe merged and devoured the source of the Fierce Sun, the scope of the extrinsic universe covering the area is equivalent to the Fierce Sun opening the heavens.

Within this range, Lin Yuan’s control over everything in the surrounding time and space reaches nearly its peak, which is why he could easily force King Lingshen out of the state of merging into ‘spirit’.

By combining the internal universe as the foundation, the Divine Ability ‘World’, and the Divine Ability ‘Fierce Sun Opening the Heavens’, Lin Yuan’s methods become terrifyingly vast.

This is just the enhancement of the Divine Ability ‘World’.

The improvement of his own foundation after the internal universe merges and devours the ‘source of the Fierce Sun’ is also immeasurable.

Moreover, with the concealment of the internal universe, unless Lin Yuan goes all out, or activates the Divine Ability ‘World’, ‘Fierce Sun Opening the Heavens’, with great connection to the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, won’t be easily exposed.

“Hmm?”

After collecting the various weapons and treasures left by King Lingshen, Lin Yuan glanced at them.

Among the numerous weapons, the silver long knife was the most striking, and it was also King Lingshen’s primary combat weapon.

“Heavenly Venerate-level weapon?”

Lin Yuan instantly recognized the level of this weapon, a Heavenly Venerate of this realm, comparable to the ‘Great Saint’ in the Chaos Void.

“Not bad.”

Lin Yuan was slightly satisfied. Although he didn’t wield blades, a Heavenly Venerate-level weapon could be easily exchanged for other resources of the same level.

This silver long knife, considered King Lingshen’s main combat weapon, is superior even among Heavenly Venerate-level weapons.

Besides the silver long knife, there was also a Heavenly Venerate-level armor and several other weapons. In terms of treasures and rare items, what King Lingshen carried with him was remarkably plentiful.

“The core royal families of this Fang Yuan World, they are truly rich…”

Lin Yuan’s heart was joyful, and he could also infer that these weapons, treasures, and rare items probably made up most of King Lingshen’s assets.

Under normal circumstances, participating in the wars of two Ancient Countries, even if only in local skirmishes, those Great Lords who participate generally wouldn’t carry precious weapons and treasures with them.

After all, the variables of war are too great, and if one were to fall, those would all end up in the hands of the enemy.

But King Lingshen? As a core royal family member grown to the limit, King Lingshen never imagined he would die.

In all the possible scenarios King Lingshen envisioned, the worst outcome was that there would also be a core royal family sitting in Qingfen Domain, and they would fight desperately with him, leading to a stalemate in the battle.

In any possible result, King Lingshen never expected anything to happen to himself.

This is also very normal, a core royal family who has grown to the limit, is invincible among Great Lords, unless encountering a Heavenly Venerate?

Otherwise, it is very challenging to fall to death, and a Heavenly Venerate?

On the battlefield, once a Heavenly Venerate-level strongman appears, it indicates that the intensity of the war has fully escalated.

And a high and mighty Heavenly Venerate wouldn’t go so far as to kill him, a core royal family member at the limit.

…

After roughly scanning through the spoils of war.

Lin Yuan looked down at the battlefield below.

At this moment, on the battlefield, twenty or thirty Great Lords of the Da Ling Ancient Country, whether newly promoted or peak Great Lords, all began to flee madly.

It was evident they also knew the result of the fight between Lin Yuan and King Lingshen.

“Trying to escape?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts flickered.

To deal with these ordinary Great Lords, Lin Yuan naturally didn’t need to activate the Divine Ability ‘World’ again.

The power of the Fierce Sun World swept over, and like fish in water, all twenty or thirty Great Lords were captured and suppressed.

“Galaxy!”

The hearts of the twenty or thirty Great Lords were filled with anxiety and fear.

“Rest assured, I won’t kill you.”

Lin Yuan stated directly.

The most cost-effective way to deal with these war captives is not to kill them, but to wait for the war to end, and then let the Da Ling Ancient Country ‘ransom’ them back.

Lin Yuan had no hatred towards these Great Lords war captives; they were simply on opposing sides, so there naturally wouldn’t be any venting of anger.

And even if killed, the other side would not completely die, as life-saving measures could still revive them, albeit at the loss of a primary combat body.

The meaning isn’t very significant.

Exchanging these captives for the Da Ling Ancient Country’s ‘ransom’ is what serves Lin Yuan’s interests most.

Great Lords fought for the Da Ling Ancient Country, and now being captured, would the Da Ling Ancient Country really stand by idly?

“Spirit Might King?”

Lin Yuan’s expression moved slightly, looking toward a distant place.

There, a presence was rapidly retreating.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared.

Moments later, when he reappeared, he was already near the Spirit Might King.

Compared to these ancient royal families who comprehend and exploit bloodline power, Lin Yuan’s mastery of the rules is equally adept, particularly the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, which he achieved in the Eighth Realm long ago.
